scientific.integrity: The unrestricted result is proved symbolically from the signed total Roman definition; finite enumeration is used only as a boundary and counting check.
limitations: Restricted to connected crown graphs Cr_n with n at least three.
The exhaustive checker covers n=3 through 8; the proof and counting argument are symbolic for arbitrary n.
Full text of two highly relevant recent sources was not retrievable during this review, so possible hidden equivalent statements remain a residual originality risk.

title: Signed total Roman domination of crown graphs
